extraction_notes: Revenue and Primary deficits are reported as 0 because the state had a surplus in 2016-17. Debt percentage refers to 'fiscal liabilities to GSDP'. 'PAC recommendations pending' refers to excess expenditure cases from previous years yet to be discussed by PAC (Table 2.3, page 67).
